findings: The prior clearance defect is resolved: interpolated retreat samples are excluded, and the frozen 0.06 m criterion is evaluated only from fresh 20 Hz observations labeled `clear_dwell` after the guarded retreat reaches its terminal target.
Qualification requires at least two terminal-dwell observations and conservatively subtracts authored fingertip-collider bounding radii from distance to the complete current screen solid.

The component aggregation remains scoped honestly and requires all native geometry, mass/inertia, contact reconciliation, grasp/lift/hold, release-clearance, and decoded-media checks to pass; it does not claim full-task or media-separation qualification.
No object-state writes, teleportation, fake grasp welds, constant success readings, or substituted observables were found in the planned source.
